propositions: Mapped project keys that are decommissioned or invisible to the bridge bot are not validated before reconcile mutation, causing failures deep in fan-out as ACLI errors.
legacy_default projects are returned unvalidated by resolve_project, potentially driving mass creates into wrong or nonexistent projects when cross-project write guards exclude creates.
A preflight probe must enumerate bot-visible projects from Jira Cloud GET /rest/api/3/project/search before any outbound mutation, validating required keys exist.

Probe failures (auth errors, transport unavailability, page exhaustion) must fail closed with distinct error messages (ProjectVisibilityError for missing keys, TransportUnavailableError for transport faults) and block reconcile.reconcile_once.
Wiring applies only to mutating passes (excluding preview, dry-run, reconcile-check) and only when backend is jira; non-Cloud backends and clients lacking _direct_rest_get are skipped observably.
